title: When Do Reusable Temporal Procedures Actually Repair Agents?
purpose: Freeze the semantics of the two Stanford-round-2 missing treatments without executing them or upgrading current claims.

G0_behavior_neutral_generic_candidate.question: Does the targeted temporal operation add value beyond behaviorally neutral extra helper computation?
G0_behavior_neutral_generic_candidate.surface: Execute exactly one helper call through the same callable wrapper as targeted/generic, but return an identity projection of the admissible evidence object in its original order.
forbidden_operations: read or compare cutoff_date/release_date for temporal filtering
map publication dates to reporting periods
select exogenous grounding events or attribution cues
inject endpoint-specific facts, labels, expected answers, or gold spans
static_preexecution_validity: same input/output wrapper surface as T/G
one helper execution per assigned endpoint
identity/order preservation over the frozen evidence object
source, schema, serialization policy, endpoint set, condition schedule, model configuration, decoding, and scorer frozen before outcomes

behavioral_neutrality.failure_rule: If G0 materially helps or harms N under the prospectively frozen neutrality criterion, G0 fails as a neutral control and cannot close TEMP-O4.

G0_behavior_neutral_generic_candidate.strengthened_operation_claim_gate: Only after G0 passes its prospective neutrality gate may a strengthened operation claim require T>N and T>G0 on the same independent endpoints; the existing G remains a target-blind stress control.

R_operation_matched_retrieval.question: Does callable skill state add value beyond an operation-matched retrieval-side implementation?
R_operation_matched_retrieval.surface: Apply the same frozen temporal operation upstream during evidence retrieval/context construction and materialize the operation output in retrieved context without the callable-skill wrapper.
information_parity_requirements: same temporal operation source/hash or mechanically verified behavioral equivalent
same selected evidence references/span IDs produced by the operation
same endpoint units and outcome scorer

interpretation_rules.T_approximately_R_at_frozen_resolution: Supports operation value only; no callable-container advantage.
interpretation_rules.R_greater_than_T: Refutes callable-container superiority for the tested regime.
interpretation_rules.prospectively_resolved_T_greater_than_R: Could motivate a separate container-value claim after scientific reopen; no such result exists now.

current_claim_boundary: R12 estimates only operation value under the executed N/G/T intervention. Behavior-neutral-compute value and callable-container value remain unresolved.
